verdict.rationale: The evidence shows QuickBooks Payroll has a developer surface: the QuickBooks Workforce API, with GraphQL, OAuth, webhooks and a sandbox. Nothing in the pack mentions API versioning, version pinning, changelogs or a deprecation policy, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. An API product can fairly be asked this question, so the axis applies and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
